description_en: Queries the details of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
name: DescribeDBInstanceAttribute

parameters.help_en: This parameter is deprecated. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 该参数已废弃，无需传入该参数
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the instance IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

AvailabilityValue.description_en:
The availability status of the instance. Unit: percentage (%).

This parameter is applicable only to instances in storage reservation mode
AvailabilityValue.description_zh:
查询当前实例可用性状态，单位：百分比（%）。

该参数仅适用存储预留模式的实例

CacheStorageSize.description_en: The total size of the cache disk. Unit: GB

ConnectionMode.description_en:
The access mode. Valid values:

Performance: standard access mode.
Safty: high-security access mode.
LVS: LVS link mode
ConnectionMode.description_zh:
访问模式，取值说明：

Performance：标准访问模式。
Safty：高安全访问模式。
LVS：LVS链路模式

CoreVersion.description_en: The minor version of the kernel

CpuCores.description_en: The number of CPU cores per compute node. Unit: cores

CpuCoresPerNode.description_en:
The number of CPU cores per node.

This parameter is applicable only to instances in storage reservation mode
CpuCoresPerNode.description_zh:
单节点的CPU核数。

该参数仅适用存储预留模式的实例

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created

DBInstanceCategory.description_en:
The instance edition. Valid values:

Basic: Basic Edition.
HighAvailability: High-availability Edition
DBInstanceCategory.description_zh:
实例系列，取值说明：

Basic：基础版。
HighAvailability：高可用版

DBInstanceClass.description_en:
The instance specifications.

This parameter is applicable only to instances in storage reservation mode
DBInstanceClass.description_zh:
实例规格。

该参数仅适用存储预留模式的实例

DBInstanceClassType.description_en:
The instance family. Valid values:

s: shared.
x: general-purpose.
d: dedicated.
h: dedicated host
DBInstanceClassType.description_zh:
实例规格族，取值说明：

s：共享型。
x：通用型。
d：独享套餐。
h：独占物理机

DBInstanceDiskMBPS.description_en:
The maximum disk throughput of the compute group. Unit: Mbit/s.

This parameter is applicable only to instances in storage reservation mode
DBInstanceDiskMBPS.description_zh:
计算组最大的BPS（磁盘吞吐量），单位：Mbps。

该参数仅适用存储预留模式的实例

DBInstanceGroupCount.description_en:
The number of compute groups.

This parameter is applicable only to instances in storage reservation mode
DBInstanceGroupCount.description_zh:
计算组数量。

该参数仅适用存储预留模式的实例

DBInstanceMemory.description_en:
The memory size of the compute node.

The unit is MB for instances in storage reservation mode and GB for instances in Serverless mode or storage elastic mode
DBInstanceMemory.description_zh:
计算节点的内存。

存储预留模式的单位为MB；Serverless和存储弹性模式单位为GB

DBInstanceMode.description_en:
The resource type of the instance. Valid values:

Serverless: Serverless mode.
StorageElastic: storage elastic mode.
Classic: storage reservation mode
DBInstanceMode.description_zh:
实例资源类型，取值说明：

Serverless：Serverless模式。
StorageElastic：存储弹性模式。
Classic：存储预留模式

DBInstanceNetType.description_en: This parameter is deprecated and no value is returned
DBInstanceNetType.description_zh: 该参数已废弃，不会返回参数值

DBInstanceStatus.description_en: The instance status. For more information, see the supplementary description of the DBInstanceStatus parameter
DBInstanceStatus.description_zh: 实例状态，详细说明请参见DBInstanceStatus参数补充说明

DBInstanceStorage.description_en: The maximum storage capacity per replica. Unit: GB
DBInstanceStorage.description_zh: 单个副本的最大存储空间，单位：GB

EncryptionKey.description_en:
The encryption key.

This parameter is returned only for instances with cloud disk encryption enabled
EncryptionKey.description_zh:
加密密钥。

仅开启云盘加密的实例会返回该参数

EncryptionType.description_en:
The encryption type. Valid values:

CloudDisk: cloud disk encryption.

This parameter is returned only for instances with cloud disk encryption enabled
EncryptionType.description_zh:
加密类型，取值说明：

CloudDisk：云盘加密。

仅云盘加密的实例会返回该参数

ExpireTime.description_en:
The time when the instance expires (UTC).

The expiration time of a pay-as-you-go instance is `2999-09-08T16:00:00Z`
ExpireTime.description_zh:
实例到期时间（UTC时间）。

按量付费实例的到期时间为`2999-09-08T16:00:00Z`

GraphEngineStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the graph engine is enabled. Valid values:
enabled: The graph engine is enabled.
disabled: The graph engine is disabled
GraphEngineStatus.description_zh:
是否开启图引擎。取值说明：
enabled：表示开启图引擎。
disabled：表示已关闭图引擎

HostType.description_en:
The machine type of the compute group. Valid values:
0: SSD
1: HDD

This parameter is applicable only to instances in storage reservation mode
HostType.description_zh:
计算组机器类型，取值说明：
0：SSD
1：HDD

该参数仅适用存储预留模式的实例

IdleTime.description_en:
The wait time before the instance is released when idle. Unit: seconds.

This parameter is returned only for Serverless instances in automatic scheduling mode
IdleTime.description_zh:
空闲释放等待时长。单位为秒。

仅Serverless自动调度模式实例返回该参数

InstanceNetworkType.description_en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:

Classic: classic network.
VPC: VPC
InstanceNetworkType.description_zh:
实例网络类型，取值说明：

Classic：经典网络。
VPC：VPC网络

LockMode.description_en:
The lock mode. Valid values:

Unlock: unlocked.
ManualLock: manually locked.
LockByExpiration: automatically locked upon instance expiration.
LockByRestoration: automatically locked before instance rollback.
LockByDiskQuota: automatically locked when the storage is full
LockMode.description_zh:
锁定方式，取值说明：

Unlock：正常 。
ManualLock：手动触发锁定。
LockByExpiration：实例过期自动锁定。
LockByRestoration：实例回滚前的自动锁定。
LockByDiskQuota：实例空间满自动锁定

LockReason.description_en: This parameter is deprecated and no value is returned
LockReason.description_zh: 该参数已废弃，故不会返回参数值

MaintainEndTime.description_en: The end time of the maintenance window

MaintainStartTime.description_en: The start time of the maintenance window

MasterAISpec.description_en: The AI node specifications of the master node. If the master node is not an AI node, an empty value is returned
MasterAISpec.description_zh: 返回实例的Master AI节点规格。如果Master节点非AI节点，则返回空值

MaxConnections.description_en:
The maximum number of concurrent connections to the instance.

This parameter is applicable only to instances in storage reservation mode
MaxConnections.description_zh:
实例的最大并发连接数。

该参数仅适用存储预留模式的实例

MemoryPerNode.description_en:
The memory size per replica. For the unit, see the MemoryUnit parameter.

This parameter is applicable only to instances in storage reservation mode
MemoryPerNode.description_zh:
单副本的内存大小，单位请参见MemoryUnit参数。

该参数仅适用存储预留模式的实例

MemorySize.description_en:
The memory size of the compute node.

The unit is MB for instances in storage reservation mode and GB for instances in Serverless mode or storage elastic mode
MemorySize.description_zh:
计算节点内存大小。

存储预留模式的单位为MB；Serverless和存储弹性模式单位为GB

MemoryUnit.description_en:
The memory unit.

This parameter is applicable only to instances in storage reservation mode
MemoryUnit.description_zh:
内存单位。

该参数仅适用存储预留模式的实例

PayType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
PayType.description_zh:
计费类型，取值说明：

Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：包年包月

Port.description_en: The port number of the instance

ReadDelayTime.description_en: This parameter is deprecated and no value is returned
ReadDelayTime.description_zh: 该参数已废弃，故不会返回参数值

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs

RunningTime.description_en: The running duration of the instance

SecurityIPList.description_en: This parameter is deprecated and no value is returned
SecurityIPList.description_zh: 该参数已废弃，不会返回参数值

SegDiskPerformanceLevel.description_en: The performance level (PL). Only PL1 is supported
SegDiskPerformanceLevel.description_zh: 性能级别PL（Performance Level），目前仅支持PL1

SegNodeNum.description_en:
The number of segment nodes.

This parameter is applicable only to instances in storage elastic mode or Serverless manual scheduling mode
SegNodeNum.description_zh:
Segment节点数量。

该参数仅适用存储弹性模式和Serverless手动调度模式的实例

SegmentAISpec.description_en: The AI node specifications of the compute nodes. If the compute nodes are not AI nodes, an empty value is returned
SegmentAISpec.description_zh: 返回实例的计算AI节点规格。如果计算节点非AI节点，则返回空值

SegmentCounts.description_en:
The number of compute groups.

This parameter is applicable only to instances in storage reservation mode
SegmentCounts.description_zh:
计算组个数。

该参数仅适用存储预留模式的实例

ServerlessMode.description_en:
The mode of the Serverless instance. Valid values:

Manual: manual scheduling.
Auto: automatic scheduling.

This parameter is returned only for Serverless instances.
The automatic scheduling mode for AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL Serverless is in invitational preview. To use this feature, submit a ticket (https://smartservice.console.aliyun.com/service/create-ticket?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.18ce281fyYBKUw&product=rds) to apply for access
ServerlessMode.description_zh:
Serverless实例的模式，取值如下：

Manual：手动调度。
Auto：自动调度。

仅Serverless模式实例返回该参数。
云原生数据仓库 AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 版Serverless自动调度模式正在邀测中。如需使用，请您提交工单 (https://smartservice.console.aliyun.com/service/create-ticket?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.18ce281fyYBKUw&product=rds)申请邀测资格

ServerlessResource.description_en:
The compute resource threshold. Unit: ACU.

This parameter is returned only for Serverless instances in automatic scheduling mode
ServerlessResource.description_zh:
计算资源阈值。单位为ACU。

仅Serverless自动调度模式实例返回该参数

StartTime.description_en: The time when the instance started running

StoragePerNode.description_en:
The storage size per replica. For the unit, see the StorageUnit parameter.

This parameter is applicable only to instances in storage reservation mode
StoragePerNode.description_zh:
单副本的存储大小，单位请参见StorageUnit参数。

该参数仅适用存储预留模式的实例

StorageType.description_en:
The storage type. Valid values:

cloud_essd: Enterprise SSD (ESSD) cloud disk.
cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.

This parameter is applicable only to instances in storage elastic mode
StorageType.description_zh:
存储类型，取值说明：

cloud_essd：ESSD云盘。
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。

该参数仅适用存储弹性模式的实例

StorageUnit.description_en:
The storage unit. Valid values:

GB SSD
TB SSD
GB HDD

This parameter is applicable only to instances in storage reservation mode
StorageUnit.description_zh:
存储单位，取值说明：

GB SSD
TB SSD
GB HDD

该参数仅适用存储预留模式的实例

SupportRestore.description_en:
Indicates whether backup and restoration is supported. Valid values:

true: Backup and restoration is supported.
false: Backup and restoration is not supported
SupportRestore.description_zh:
是否支持备份恢复，取值说明：

true：支持备份恢复。
false：不支持备份恢复

VectorConfigurationStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether vector engine optimization is enabled. Valid values:
enabled: Vector engine optimization is enabled.
disabled: Vector engine optimization is disabled
VectorConfigurationStatus.description_zh:
是否开启向量引擎优化，取值说明：
enabled：表示开启向量引擎优化。
disabled：表示已关闭向量引擎优化
